subject: mathematics
description: Past year questions on Inverse Circular Functions and Trigonometric Equations

questions.question: Find the principal value of sin⁻¹(-1/2).
questions.solution:
sin⁻¹(-1/2) = -π/6 (or -30°)

Principal value range of sin⁻¹ is [-π/2, π/2]. Since sin(-π/6) = -1/2, the answer is -π/6.
questions.knowledgeNote: sin⁻¹ range: [-π/2, π/2]; cos⁻¹ range: [0, π]; tan⁻¹ range: (-π/2, π/2).

questions.question: Find cos⁻¹(√3/2) + sin⁻¹(1/2).
questions.knowledgeNote: sin⁻¹(x) + cos⁻¹(x) = π/2 for all x ∈ [-1,1]. This identity is very useful.

questions.question: Solve: 2sin²θ - sin θ - 1 = 0 for 0 ≤ θ ≤ 2π
questions.solution:
2sin²θ - sin θ - 1 = 0
(2sin θ + 1)(sin θ - 1) = 0

Case 1: sin θ = -1/2 → θ = 7π/6, 11π/6
Case 2: sin θ = 1 → θ = π/2

**Solutions: θ = π/2, 7π/6, 11π/6**
questions.knowledgeNote: General solution: sin θ = sin α → θ = nπ + (-1)ⁿα. For specific intervals, check all valid n.

questions.question: Solve: cos 2θ = cos θ
questions.solution:
cos 2θ = cos θ
2cos²θ - 1 = cos θ
2cos²θ - cos θ - 1 = 0
(2cos θ + 1)(cos θ - 1) = 0

Case 1: cos θ = 1 → θ = 0, 2π
Case 2: cos θ = -1/2 → θ = 2π/3, 4π/3

**Solutions: θ = 0, 2π/3, 4π/3, 2π**
